snippet.title: Tails of Iron 2 | Blood & Brine Free Expansion | Out NOW on PC, PlayStation, Xbox & Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Take on 10 new bosses, complete 11 new quests, go fishing in the dangerous waters of Hardshell Brook, and unlock new armour — including crossover sets inspired by Blasphemous, Cult of the Lamb, DAVE THE DIVER, Death’s Door and Moonlighter.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473480/Tails_of_Iron_2_Whiskers_of_Winter/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009898 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/tails-of-iron-2-whiskers-of-winter/9ppkmqfxr7fr
